newsitem.title: FRANCE: Connaught to seek FDA clearance for lyme vaccine.
newsitem.headline: Connaught to seek FDA clearance for lyme vaccine.

text.p: Pasteur Merieux Connaught said on Wednesday it planned to submit a product licence application in coming months to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for a vaccine against Lyme disease.
The company, part of chemicals group Rhone-Poulenc, said it planned to offer the vaccine to all study participants who received placebo during phase 3 of a series of clinical trials.
Pasteur Merieux completed the phase 3 trial designed to study the vaccine against the tick-borne disease in humans in March 1996.
The phase 3 trial involved more than 10,000 volunteers and was conducted in the U.S. states of Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York and Wisconsin where the disease is endemic.
In 1996 nearly 14,000 cases of Lyme disease were reported in the United States.
